patch_tools.name: read_file
patch_tools.description_append: Set host to a known SSH alias to read the file on that remote host instead of the workspace filesystem. Prefer this structured remote access over running ssh or cat through exec/bash.

host.description: Optional SSH host alias from remote_hosts. When omitted, operate on the workspace filesystem.

patch_tools.name: read_files
patch_tools.description_append: Set host to a known SSH alias to read the files on that remote host instead of the workspace filesystem.

host.description: Optional SSH host alias from remote_hosts. When omitted, operate on the workspace filesystem.

patch_tools.description_append: Set host to a known SSH alias to write the file on that remote host instead of the workspace filesystem.

host.description: Optional SSH host alias from remote_hosts. When omitted, operate on the workspace filesystem.

patch_tools.description_append: Set host to a known SSH alias to edit the file on that remote host instead of the workspace filesystem.

host.description: Optional SSH host alias from remote_hosts. When omitted, operate on the workspace filesystem.

patch_tools.name: edit_files
patch_tools.description_append: Set host to a known SSH alias to edit the files on that remote host instead of the workspace filesystem.

host.description: Optional SSH host alias from remote_hosts. When omitted, operate on the workspace filesystem.

patch_tools.name: file_info
patch_tools.description_append: Set host to a known SSH alias to inspect the path on that remote host instead of the workspace filesystem.

host.description: Optional SSH host alias from remote_hosts. When omitted, operate on the workspace filesystem.

patch_tools.name: list_directory
patch_tools.description_append: Set host to a known SSH alias to list a directory on that remote host instead of the workspace filesystem.

host.description: Optional SSH host alias from remote_hosts. When omitted, operate on the workspace filesystem.

patch_tools.name: create_directory
patch_tools.description_append: Set host to a known SSH alias to create the directory on that remote host instead of the workspace filesystem.

host.description: Optional SSH host alias from remote_hosts. When omitted, operate on the workspace filesystem.

patch_tools.name: move_file
patch_tools.description_append: Set host to a known SSH alias to move or rename the path on that remote host instead of the workspace filesystem.

host.description: Optional SSH host alias from remote_hosts. When omitted, operate on the workspace filesystem.

patch_tools.name: search_start
patch_tools.description_append: Set host to a known SSH alias to search the remote filesystem. Prefer this over invoking ssh plus grep/find/rg.

host.description: Optional SSH host alias from remote_hosts. When omitted, search the workspace filesystem.

patch_tools.name: exec
patch_tools.description_append: Set host to a known SSH alias to execute argv on that remote host without asking the assistant to construct a quoted ssh command. Prefer host over putting ssh in argv.

host.description: Optional SSH host alias from remote_hosts. When omitted, execute in the workspace.

patch_tools.name: bash
patch_tools.description_append: Set host to a known SSH alias when intentional shell syntax must run remotely. Do not wrap a remote command in ssh yourself. Prefer exec with host when shell syntax is not required.

host.description: Optional SSH host alias from remote_hosts. When omitted, execute in the workspace.

patch_tools.name: process_start
patch_tools.description_append: Set host to a known SSH alias to start the durable process on that remote host. Prefer argv mode unless shell syntax is required. The returned process_id is an opaque handle for process_output/process_input/process_signal.

host.description: Optional SSH host alias from remote_hosts. When omitted, start the process in the workspace.

patch_tools.name: process_output
patch_tools.description_append: The process_id may refer to a process started on a remote host by process_start(host=...). The opaque handle carries its target.

patch_tools.name: process_input
patch_tools.description_append: The process_id may refer to an interactive process started on a remote host by process_start(host=...). The opaque handle carries its target.

patch_tools.name: process_signal
patch_tools.description_append: The process_id may refer to a process started on a remote host by process_start(host=...). The opaque handle carries its target.

patch_tools.name: process_list
patch_tools.description_append: Set host to a known SSH alias when recovering or listing durable processes for that remote target after an uncertain process_start result. Remote entries include target metadata.

host.description: Optional SSH host alias from remote_hosts. When omitted, list workspace-local tracked processes.

patch_tools.name: search_results
patch_tools.description_append: The search_id may refer to a search started on a remote host by search_start(host=...). The opaque handle carries its target.

patch_tools.name: search_stop
patch_tools.description_append: The search_id may refer to a search started on a remote host by search_start(host=...). The opaque handle carries its target.

patch_tools.name: search_list
patch_tools.description_append: List workspace-local and remote search sessions started by search_start. Remote entries include target metadata.

add_tools.name: remote_hosts
add_tools.description: List SSH host aliases available to the workspace, with safe connection metadata only. Use this to discover a remote target before setting host on file, search, exec, bash, process, HTTP, copy, or remove tools. Never returns private key contents or credential values.

workspace.description: Workspace whose SSH configuration and known remote targets should be inspected.

add_tools.name: copy_path
add_tools.description: Copy a file or directory between workspace and/or remote SSH targets without shell quoting. Source and destination may independently be local to the workspace or use a known host alias. Use this instead of cp, scp, rsync, tar-over-ssh, or base64 transfer when a direct copy is intended.

workspace.description: Workspace that owns the local filesystem and SSH configuration for this transfer.

host.description: Optional source SSH host alias. Omit for the workspace filesystem.
Optional destination SSH host alias. Omit for the workspace filesystem.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing destination. Defaults to false.

add_tools.name: remove_path
add_tools.description: Remove a file or directory from the workspace or a known remote SSH host. This is destructive. Use only when removal is the requested action, instead of rm through exec/bash.

workspace.description: Workspace that owns the local filesystem and SSH configuration.

host.description: Optional SSH host alias. When omitted, remove from the workspace filesystem.

recursive.description: Allow removing a non-empty directory. Defaults to false.

add_tools.name: http_fetch
add_tools.description: Perform a structured read-only HTTP GET or HEAD request from the workspace or a known remote SSH host. Prefer this over curl/wget for ordinary probes and document retrieval. Does not support mutating HTTP methods.

workspace.description: Workspace from whose network context the request is made.

host.description: Optional SSH host alias. When set, originate the HTTP request from that remote host.

method.description: Read-only HTTP method. Defaults to GET.

headers.description: Optional request headers. Secret header values must not be persisted in activity metadata.

max_body_bytes.description: Maximum response body bytes returned to the assistant.

add_tools.name: http_request
add_tools.description: Perform a structured HTTP request that may mutate remote state, such as POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE, from the workspace or a known remote SSH host. Prefer this over curl when an HTTP API call is the intended action.

workspace.description: Workspace from whose network context the request is made.

host.description: Optional SSH host alias. When set, originate the HTTP request from that remote host.

headers.description: Optional request headers. Secret header values must not be persisted in activity metadata.

follow_redirects.description: Follow redirects. Defaults to false for mutating requests.

max_body_bytes.description: Maximum response body bytes returned to the assistant.

add_tools.name: code_query
add_tools.description: Query language-server code intelligence without modifying files. Use this for semantic symbols, definitions, references, diagnostics, hover information, or call hierarchy. Use search_start instead for literal or regex text search.

path.description: Absolute source file path when the operation requires a location.

symbol.description: Optional symbol name for symbol-oriented queries.

add_tools.name: code_rename
add_tools.description: Rename a code symbol semantically through the language server, updating references across the project. This modifies files. Prefer this over text replacement when the requested change is a symbol rename.

path.description: Absolute source file path containing the symbol.
